description: This file declares internal utility functions for handling PKCS12 encoding/decoding, including password processing, hashing, key derivation, encryption, decryption, and HMAC. It is part of the PKCS12 utility implementation used in a larger PKI system.

methods.name: PKCS12UtilityPasswordToBMPString
methods.description: Converts a password string to BMP Unicode format.

methods.name: PKCS12UtilityConcatenateString
methods.description: Concatenates two byte strings into a new buffer, which the caller must free.

methods.name: PKCS12UtilityHashString
methods.description: Hashes a message using specified hash type and iterations.

methods.name: PKCS12UtilityConcatenateAndHash
methods.description: Concatenates two messages and computes their hash with specified iterations.

methods.name: PKCS12UtilityGetDerivedKey
methods.description: Derives a cryptographic key from a password and salt for PKCS12.

methods.name: PKCS12UtilityGetPKCS5DerivedKey
methods.description: Derives a key and IV for PKCS5 from a password and salt.

methods.name: PKCS12UtilityDecrypt
methods.description: Decrypts data using specified cryptographic algorithm and password.

methods.name: PKCS12UtilityEncrypt
methods.description: Encrypts data using specified cryptographic algorithm and password.

methods.name: PKCS12UtilityGetHMAC
methods.description: Generates HMAC of a message with a password-derived key.
